status_label: Public reference patterns, not market-share findings
application_note: Scenario suitability and authority notes are exercise design guidance; they do not claim implemented capabilities.

cards.title: Deterministic workflow
cards.when: Use when inputs, conditions and the processing order can be specified.
cards.cost_dimensions: Cost of maintaining rules, exceptions and tests.
cards.when_not: A fixed flow may be insufficient when unknown conditions require judgement.

cards.title: Retrieval-grounded answers
cards.when: Use when answers depend on accessible, maintainable sources.
cards.cost_dimensions: Source preparation, chunking, retrieval, updates and evaluation at each stage.
cards.when_not: An answer alone is insufficient when sources are missing or an action is required.

source.title: Design and develop a RAG solution

cards.title: Agent with confirmation
cards.when: Consider when steps and tools must be selected dynamically; define human checkpoints.
cards.cost_dimensions: Tool definitions, checkpoints, latency, cost and compounding errors.
cards.when_not: Do not claim autonomous execution for simple predictable flows or unavailable tools.

cards.title: Human handling
cards.when: Keep human checkpoints for uncertain or authority-limited steps.
cards.cost_dimensions: Human time, handoff information and decision responsibility.
cards.when_not: Handoff is a process step; it does not prove completion.
